```{r}
Sleep_health_and_lifestyle_dataset <- read_csv("~/Downloads/Health and Sleep relation 2024/Sleep_health_and_lifestyle_dataset.csv",show_col_types = F)
colnames(Sleep_health_and_lifestyle_dataset)
```
# Preprocesamiento y limpieza de datos.
```{r}
Sleep_health_and_lifestyle_dataset$`BMI Category`<-recode(Sleep_health_and_lifestyle_dataset$`BMI Category`,
  "Normal Weight" = "Normal")
table(Sleep_health_and_lifestyle_dataset$`Sleep Disorder`)
```

```{r}
# Cargar librerías necesarias
library(caret)      # Para preprocesamiento y modelado
library(visdat)     # Para visualización de datos faltantes
library(corrplot)   # Para matriz de correlación

sleep_data <- Sleep_health_and_lifestyle_dataset %>% dplyr::select(!c(`Person ID`))
colnames(sleep_data) <- make.names(colnames(sleep_data))
sleep_data$`Daily.Steps`<-sleep_data$`Daily.Steps`/1000 #Convertir pasos diarios a miles
sleep_data$`Stress.Level`<- sleep_data$`Stress.Level`*10 #Convertir nivel de estrés a escala de 0 a 100
#Conversión de variables categóricas a factores
sleep_data <- sleep_data %>%
  mutate(
    Gender = as.factor(Gender),
    Occupation = as.factor(Occupation),
    `BMI.Category` = as.factor(`BMI.Category`),
    `Sleep.Disorder` = as.factor(`Sleep.Disorder`)
  )
#Separación de presión sanguínea
sleep_data <- sleep_data %>%
  separate(`Blood.Pressure`, into = c("Systolic_BP", "Diastolic_BP"), sep = "/") %>%
  mutate(
    Systolic_BP = as.numeric(Systolic_BP),
    Diastolic_BP = as.numeric(Diastolic_BP)
  )

```

```{r}

sleep_data$`Problemas.de.Sueño` <- as.factor(ifelse(sleep_data$`Sleep.Disorder` %in% c("Sleep Apnea","Insomnia"), "Yes", "No"))

sleep_data_rel<- sleep_data %>%
  dplyr::select(`Problemas.de.Sueño`, `Age`, `Gender`, `BMI.Category`, `Systolic_BP`, `Diastolic_BP`, `Stress.Level`,`Physical.Activity.Level`,`Heart.Rate`,`Daily.Steps`)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

p2<-ggpairs(sleep_data_rel %>%  dplyr::select(!c(Problemas.de.Sueño)), aes(color=sleep_data_rel$Problemas.de.Sueño), progress = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

numeric_vars <- sleep_data_rel[, sapply(sleep_data_rel, is.numeric)]
p <- list()
for (i in 1:ncol(numeric_vars)) {
  var_name <- names(numeric_vars)[i]
  var_data <- numeric_vars[[i]]
  
  p[[var_name]] <- ggplot(data.frame(x = var_data), aes(x = x)) +
    geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), 
                   fill = "skyblue", 
                   color = "black",
                   bins = nclass.scott(var_data)) +
    geom_density(color = "blue4", size = 1) +
    stat_function(fun = dnorm,
                 args = list(mean = mean(var_data, na.rm = TRUE),
                           sd = sd(var_data, na.rm = TRUE)),
                 color = "red", size = 1) +
    ggtitle(paste("Distribution of", var_name)) +
    xlab(var_name) +
    theme_minimal()
}

final_plot <- grid.arrange(grobs = p, ncol = 4)
ggsave("all_variables_grid.png", plot = final_plot,width = 16, height = 6,dpi = 300)
ggsave("pairplot.png", plot = p2, width = 18, height = 13.5, dpi = 300)
```


## Separacion de la base de datos en entrenamiento y prueba
```{r}
set.seed(123)
train_index <- createDataPartition(sleep_data_rel$`Problemas.de.Sueño`, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data <- sleep_data_rel[train_index, ]
test_data <- sleep_data_rel[-train_index, ]
```

#Verificacion de normalidad y homogeneidad de varianzas
```{r}
vars <- names(sleep_data_rel)[5:10]
sapply(vars, function(var) {
  tapply(sleep_data_rel[[var]], sleep_data_rel$Problemas.de.Sueño, function(x) {
    p <- shapiro.test(x)$p.value
    if (p > 0.05) {
      return(paste0("p = ", round(p, 4), " → Normal"))
    } else {
      return(paste0("p = ", round(p, 4), " → No normal"))
    }
  })
})
```
```{r}
#mvn(data = subset(train_data, `Problemas.de.Sueño` == "Yes")[6:10], mvn_test = "hz", multivariate_outlier_method = "quan")
#mvn(data = subset(train_data, `Problemas.de.Sueño` == "No")[6:10], mvn_test = "hz", multivariate_outlier_method = "quan")
```
No los muestro porque no se cumplen los supuestos de normalidad, pero leyendo un poco sobre el tema entendi que si los datos son simetricos y la precision es alta, se puede seguir usando LDA


```{r}
car::leveneTest(Diastolic_BP~Problemas.de.Sueño,data=train_data)
car::leveneTest(Systolic_BP~Problemas.de.Sueño,data=train_data)
car::leveneTest(Stress.Level~Problemas.de.Sueño,data=train_data)
car::leveneTest(Physical.Activity.Level~Problemas.de.Sueño,data=train_data)
car::leveneTest(Heart.Rate~Problemas.de.Sueño,data=train_data)
car::leveneTest(Daily.Steps~Problemas.de.Sueño,data=train_data)
```

## Modelo de regresión logística
```{r}
modelo_logit<-glm(data = train_data, `Problemas.de.Sueño`~ .,family= binomial(link = "logit"))

summary(modelo_logit)
```
### Seleccion por pasos

```{r}
modelo_logit_step<- step(modelo_logit, direction = "both", trace = FALSE)
summary(modelo_logit_step)
```
```{r}
predicciones_logit <- predict(modelo_logit, newdata = test_data)
conf_matrix_modelo_logit<-confusionMatrix(as.factor(ifelse(predicciones_logit > 0.5, "Yes", "No")), 
                test_data$`Problemas.de.Sueño`, 
                positive = "Yes"
)
```
## Modelo LDA

```{r}

modelo_lda <- lda(`Problemas.de.Sueño` ~., data = train_data)
lda_predictions <- predict(modelo_lda,test_data)
print(modelo_lda)
```

```{r}
conf_matrix_modelo_lda<-confusionMatrix(as.factor(ifelse(lda_predictions$posterior[,2] > 0.5, "Yes", "No")), 
                test_data$`Problemas.de.Sueño`, 
                positive = "Yes",
                mode="everything")
print(conf_matrix_modelo_lda)

```

## Modelo de Árbol de Decisión

```{r}
modelo_tree <- rpart(
  formula = `Problemas.de.Sueño` ~ ., 
  data = train_data,
  method = "class",
  control = rpart.control(
    minsplit = 10,
    minbucket = 5,
  ))
```

```{r}
png("decision_tree.png", width = 1200, height = 800, res = 150)
rpart.plot(modelo_tree, 
           type = 4, 
           extra = 104,
           box.palette = "GnBu",
           branch.lty = 3, 
           shadow.col = "gray",
           nn = TRUE)
dev.off()
```
```{r}
predictions <- predict(modelo_tree, test_data, type = "class")

conf_matrix_modelo_tree <- confusionMatrix(predictions, test_data$`Problemas.de.Sueño`,positive="Yes")
print(conf_matrix_modelo_tree)

importance <- varImp(modelo_tree)
importancia_modelo_tree<-ggplot(importance, aes(x = reorder(rownames(importance), Overall), y = Overall)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Importancia de las Variables en el Modelo Arbol de Decision", x = "Variables", y = "Reducción Media en el Índice de Gini")
```

### Podado del árbol de decisión

```{r}
optimal_cp <- modelo_tree$cptable[
  which.min(modelo_tree$cptable[, "xerror"]), "CP"]

podado <- prune(modelo_tree, cp = optimal_cp)

png("podado.png", width = 1200, height = 800, res = 150)
rpart.plot(podado,
           type = 4, 
           extra = 104,
           box.palette = "GnBu",
           branch.lty = 3, 
           shadow.col = "gray")
dev.off()
```


```{r}
predictions <- predict(podado, test_data, type = "class")


conf_matrix_podado <- confusionMatrix(predictions, test_data$`Problemas.de.Sueño`)
print(conf_matrix_podado)


importance <- varImp(podado)
importancia_modelo_podado<-ggplot(importance, aes(x = reorder(rownames(importance), Overall), y = Overall)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Importancia de las Variables en el Modelo Arbol de Decision (Podado)", x = "Variables", y = "Reducción Media en el Índice de Gini")
```

## Model de Random Forest


```{r}
rf_model <- randomForest(
  `Problemas.de.Sueño` ~ .,
  data = sleep_data_rel,
  ntree = 500,       
  importance = TRUE,  
  strata = train_data$`Problemas.de.Sueño` 
)

print(rf_model)

importance_scores <- importance(rf_model, type = 2)

importance_df <- data.frame(
  Feature = rownames(importance_scores),
  Importance = importance_scores[, 1]
) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))

importancia_modelo_rf<-ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = reorder(Feature, Importance), y = Importance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Importancia de las Variables en el Modelo de Random Forest",
       x = "Variables",
       y = "Reducción Media en el Índice de Gini") +
  theme_minimal()

```
```{r}
conf_matrix_modelo_rf <- confusionMatrix(predict(rf_model, sleep_data_rel), sleep_data_rel$`Problemas.de.Sueño`, positive = "Yes")
print(conf_matrix_modelo_rf)
```
